metadata.name: dims
metadata.description: rendered extent; sheet.addrow grows rows to cover each appended task (the board/next-id ranges reach to row 40)

cels.v: Rebuild kanban as a sheets-app document — the board is a =view over this sheet
replaced the kanbanapp origin-application; drag a card to move it between columns
Task form view — add new tasks from a form into this sheet
sheet.addrow is the mechanism; the columns, next-id rule and cleared drafts are authored in H4:H8
Profile → sheets app: 🔐 supabase login view + 👤 wallet view (doc:identity)
login + sb.default config moved OUT of chatrooms into the identity doc; tokens stay in the session store behind a SecretHandle, never a cel
Persist sessions across reloads: wallet-sealed refresh-token sidecar + usercfg kvsheet

SHIPPED: session.restore/persist + wallet-wrapped refresh sidecars (unlock wallet = log in); usercfg kvsheet in the identity doc (composer adds keys), sb.default derives from its rows; hosted supabase project seeded as default
usercfg survives refreshApps: install-once manifests + =kvseed defaults merge

usercfg ships EMPTY + install:'once' (never re-put); usercfg_defaults is the stompable layer; =kvseed('usercfg','usercfg_defaults') on the identity sheet merges missing keys every open — user values always win, deletion = reset-to-default

metadata.name: H1
metadata.description: the KANBAN BOARD view: four status columns FILTER the task rows (id = row - 1 indexes the B/C/D ranges); a card drags via drag.grab naming its OWN status cel and a column drop assigns its name — movement is a setValue, the board re-renders through the graph

cels.f:
=view('📋 board', LET(
	ids, FILTER(A2:A40, LAMBDA(id, id > 0)),
	cardOf, LAMBDA(id, dom('div.kcard',
		attr('draggable', 'true'),
		on('dragstart', 'drag.grab', CONCAT('kanban.C', id + 1)),
		dom('div.ktitle', INDEX(B2:B40, id)),
		dom('div.kwho', INDEX(D2:D40, id)))),
	colOf, LAMBDA(name, dom('div.kcol',
		attr('data-col', name),
		on('dragover', 'drag.over'),
		on('drop', 'drag.drop', name),
		dom('h3', name),
		MAP(FILTER(ids, LAMBDA(id, INDEX(C2:C40, id) = name)), cardOf))),
	dom('div.kboard',
		dom('style', '.kboard{display:flex;gap:.6rem;padding:.5rem;align-items:flex-start;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.kcol{flex:1;min-width:0;background:#8881;border:1px solid #8883;border-radius:.5rem;padding:.4rem;min-height:180px}.kcol h3{margin:.1rem 0 .5rem;font:700 .78rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#888;text-align:center}.kcard{background:Canvas;border:1px solid #8884;border-radius:.4rem;padding:.4rem .55rem;margin:.35rem 0;cursor:grab;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #0003;user-select:none}.kcard:active{cursor:grabbing}.ktitle{font:600 .76rem ui-monospace,monospace}.kwho{margin-top:.2rem;font:.68rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#888}'),
		colOf('To Do'), colOf('Doing'), colOf('Review'), colOf('Done'))))

metadata.name: H2
metadata.description: the NEW-TASK FORM view: inputs param.set the H4:H7 draft cells, the button dispatches sheet.addrow with the policy payload (H8 next-id + drafts → columns A..E, then clear title/notes) — every rule a visible cell

cels.f:
=view('➕ new task', dom('div.kform',
	dom('style', '.kform{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.45rem;max-width:24rem;padding:.6rem;font:.85rem ui-monospace,monospace}.kform label{color:#888;font-weight:600;font-size:.72rem}.kform input,.kform select{font:.85rem ui-monospace,monospace;padding:.3rem .45rem;border:1px solid #8884;border-radius:.3rem;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText}.kform button{margin-top:.4rem;padding:.4rem;border:1px solid #8884;border-radius:.3rem;background:#8881;cursor:pointer;font:700 .8rem ui-monospace,monospace}'),
	dom('label', 'task'),
	dom('input', attr('value', H4), attr('placeholder', 'what needs doing'), on('change', 'param.set', 'kanban.H4')),
	dom('label', 'status'),
	dom('select', on('change', 'param.set', 'kanban.H5'),
		dom('option', IF(H5 = 'To Do', attr('selected', 'selected'), ''), 'To Do'),
		dom('option', IF(H5 = 'Doing', attr('selected', 'selected'), ''), 'Doing'),
		dom('option', IF(H5 = 'Review', attr('selected', 'selected'), ''), 'Review'),
		dom('option', IF(H5 = 'Done', attr('selected', 'selected'), ''), 'Done')),
	dom('label', 'assignee'),
	dom('input', attr('value', H6), attr('placeholder', 'who — you, or an agent'), on('change', 'param.set', 'kanban.H6')),
	dom('label', 'notes'),
	dom('input', attr('value', H7), on('change', 'param.set', 'kanban.H7')),
	dom('button', on('click', 'sheet.addrow', {seg: 'kanban', from: ['kanban.H8', 'kanban.H4', 'kanban.H5', 'kanban.H6', 'kanban.H7'], clear: ['kanban.H4', 'kanban.H7']}), CONCAT('➕ add task #', H8))))

metadata.name: H8
metadata.description: the id RULE, as a visible formula: ids are 1..n in row order (id = row - 1), so the next task's id is the count of existing ids + 1 — sheet.addrow copies this cell's value into the new row's A column

manifests.name: kanban
manifests.description: kanban (a sheetapp document) — the TASKS worksheet is the program: a board =view (drag a card = setValue its status cel) and a new-task form =view (sheet.addrow appends a row) both derive from the same grid; agents and people share it by editing cells
